## How to take it

Comment "taking this" and wait to be assigned; only the assigned person is paid. If there is no pull request
within 7 days, the maintainer unassigns it and the task opens up again. Put `Closes #<this issue>` and
`Base address: 0x…` in the pull request description as plain lines (the template has a place for them). Rules: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/0x94t3z/fieldatlas/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributor-rewards).

<!-- Usual amounts: 5,000,000 small fix, docs or timing report; 20,000,000 feature, speed fix, or a report
that leads to a fix; 50,000,000 knowledge collection or larger agreed change (the per-task limit). -->
